name: JWH-210
summary: 69 nM at CB2.e.2 nM). It was discovered by and named after John W. Huffman.

pharmacology.text: JWH-210 is an analgesic chemical from the naphthoylindole family, which acts as a potent cannabinoid agonist at both the CB1 and CB2 receptors, with Ki values of 0.46 nM at CB1 and 0.69 nM at CB2.

summaryZh: JWH-210，化學名：1-戊基-3-(4-乙基-1-萘甲醯基)吲哚，分子式C26H27NO，是一種鎮痛藥，屬於約翰·威廉·霍夫曼小組合成的萘甲醯基吲哚類JWH系列大麻素。
summaryZhHans: JWH-210，化学名：1-戊基-3-(4-乙基-1-萘甲酰基)吲哚，分子式C26H27NO，是一种镇痛药，属于约翰·威廉·霍夫曼小组合成的萘甲酰基吲哚类JWH系列大麻素。
